description.value:
Range 30 feet

Targets 1 object, structure, or creature

Recognize exactly how something nearby is already failing or aging.

You look at the target and see the direction it is already going. You learn how it is currently failing — a structural flaw, a disease, an untreated wound, a mechanism about to seize, an age it is carrying badly — and roughly how long it has before that failing matters. You learn nothing about anything else, and a thing genuinely in good repair reads as being in good repair.
